title: History of Philosophy - From Descartes to Hume
description: A historical scene featuring key philosophers from Descartes to Hume. In the foreground, René Descartes is shown writing at a desk with mathematical diagrams, while John Locke and David Hume are engaged in animated discussion. The background includes a study with shelves of books and classical paintings. Elements like a globe, telescope, and philosophical texts symbolize the era's focus on reason, empiricism, and the scientific method. The atmosphere is scholarly and dynamic, capturing the intellectual fervor of the period.
